rules.title: Preserve lightweight vertical slices
rules.summary: Keep the public start/approve/implement/amend/verify backbone, one smallest production-shaped active slice, and non-binding candidates.

rules.title: Keep detail evidence-triggered
rules.summary: Root documents converge to as-built truth; detailed use-case, design, contract, ADR, and diagram artifacts are created only when independently useful.

rules.title: Inspect brownfield behavior before change
rules.summary: Existing-feature amendments must read current documents and implementation, preserve correct behavior, and update only affected sections and work.

rules.title: Verify owns as-built convergence
rules.summary: Final human artifacts describe confirmed implementation decisions; candidate behavior is never silently promoted.

rules.title: Preserve compatibility and proportional size
rules.summary: Keep progressive-map-v1 root headings compatible, spec.md under 320 lines, design.md under 240 lines, and simple behavior inline.

rules.title: Deterministic state and direct execution
rules.summary: Machine state stays under _kapelle; deterministic scripts own state/status JSON; helpers and inspections are direct; no Git operations.

rules.title: Narrow user-approved early-test exception
rules.summary: Only basic or concretely important tests are added early, including a focused unit test when it is the smallest useful evidence. All remaining tests and complete verification stay at verify. This user instruction supersedes the blanket unit-test ban.
rules.source: Current user instruction; AGENTS.md invariant 6; references/human-control.md; skills/implement/SKILL.md; skills/verify/SKILL.md

rules.title: Proportional completeness and standalone decisions
rules.summary: Review applicability within the existing root package, never invent numerical targets, and explain current behavior, proposal, and consequence before links. No new stages, mandatory interviews, ADR quotas, or per-criterion approvals. Behavioral fixtures do not imply a live-agent PASS.
